requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 按钮（D2）切换模式：LED（D13）闪烁/常亮/关闭
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Initial: io_0=false. Step1: press D2 rising edge (io_0: false->true) once, then release (true->false). Repeat press once more, then once more; no further presses during verification steps.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: LED io_1 cycles exactly through: initial mode off (false), then blinking mode (io_1 toggles each subsequent model step while in this mode), then steady on (true), then off again after the third press.
